sources.title: glm-5.3-flash (Zhipu AI) - Cloudflare Docs
sources.snippet: The first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
